mapper.sql:
select t.match_id as matchId, t.my_event_team_id as myEventTeamId from ( select m.id as match_id, case when m.home_event_team_id = my_et.event_team_id then m.home_event_team_id else m.away_event_team_id end as my_event_team_id, m.scheduled_start_time, m.sort_no, row_number() over ( partition by m.id order by my_et.event_team_id ) as rn from basket_match m
where ) t where t.rn = 1
mapper.select:
select distinct m.platform_code as platformCode from basket_match m
where and m.platform_code is not null and m.platform_code != '' order by m.platform_code asc
